expectations.text: Defines 'stateless' in plain words (the server keeps no per-session record) the first time it is used
expectations.evidence: Descriptive sentence immediately followed by the labeling sentence at the word's first use: "That's it: no database or session store involved." ... "That's what "stateless" means here.
